items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: Well I played with the Fallen in later years, in the brass band. But I was playing piano then, and I went with Allen during that time.

ctx.x: What instrument did you start on?

Well I started playing piano in house parties. And I went to rehearsal where Kid Howard was playing at a house party on barracks between Ramport and St. Claude. And Johnny Pradoz told Howard, say, well let's make a good piano player. He said try him in another key. So they kept on switching keys and I would follow them. They took my name and address. Well I played several jobs with them. And one day, Henry Allen was looking for a piano player, him and Albert Martin. And I was staying at 1450 St. Claude Street.…
